description: Mains plug types, voltage and frequency for Musafir's demo countries, copied from official tourism sources. See src/data/schema.ts for the verification levels.

entries.notes: 50 Hz in eastern Japan, 60 Hz in western Japan (including Nagoya, Kyoto and Osaka).

sources.quote: Power outlets use Type A plugs.
The voltage used throughout Japan is uniformly 100 volts, A.C. There are two kinds of frequencies in use—50 Hertz in eastern Japan and 60 Hertz in western Japan (including Nagoya, Kyoto and Osaka).
The voltage in Britain is 220/240 AC, 50Hz and electrical plugs (plug type G) have three rectangular pins
